name: Background lifecycle verification companion
purpose: Separately packaged real foreground service for background-list/Stop proof. No network, external data or production filter exception. One nonce-owned private heartbeat; refuses replacement; expires after 90 seconds; never starts at boot or restarts sticky.
installedBy: Coordinator installs canonical targets/android/build-verify-background.sh output using tools/phone/adb.sh install -r; never auto-installed by checks
unbounded: Android-managed com.powos.verifybackground process/UID; one handler, one private heartbeat file, 90-second elapsed-time cap. Queue cleanup only with matching nonce and PID; Stop uses unchanged BackgroundApps.stop.
